title: Ajab Zehra Ke Bete Ki Ghareebi Ka Zamana Hai
body:
Ajab Zehra Ke Bete Ki Ghareebi Ka Zamana Hai
kamar Tooti Hai Aur Abbas Ka Lasha Uthana Hai
1. Tarayi Par Jise Loota Hai Milkar Shaam Walo'n Ne
ali-e-murtaza Ke Daman-e-dil Ka Khazana Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Layee'n Kehte The Abbas-e-jari Ko Qatl Kardalo
agar Is Aalam-e-ghurbath Me Sarwar Ko Rulana Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Wafa Ghazi Ki Kehti Thi Pharere Ka Lahu Pocho
alam Ko Bibiyon Ke Darmiya'n Khaime Me Jana Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kaha Shabbir Ne Amma Sambhalo Haath Ghazi Ke
inhe Bali Sakina Ki Nigaho'n Se Chupana Ha
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ridaye'n Roke Kehti Thi Na Jao Janib-e-dariya
tumhe Toh Zainab-o-kulsoom Ka Parda Bachana Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Huva Hai Imteha'n Kab Khatm Ghazi Ke Kate Sar Ka
abhi Toh Berida Behno'n Ko Lekar Shaam Jana Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ajal Akber Ke Lashe Par Yeh Kehkar Bain Karti Thi
jigar Hai Noujawani Ka Magar Naiza Purana Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Yeh Kehkar Dasht Me Sheh Turbat-e-asghar Banate Hai
mujhe Aye Zulfeqar Ab Sabr Tera Aazmana Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Bilal-e-kazmi Ta'zindagi Abbas Ke Gham Me
yunhi Likh Likh Ke Masoomeen Ko Nouhay Sunana Hai
